_about: Java Edition combat (1.9+ cooldown combat, as of 1.21). Item damage and attack speed are read from the game at runtime; these are the rules around them.

attack_cooldown.fact: After each swing the attack recharges over 1 / attack_speed seconds. A hit before it's recharged does reduced damage (damage scales with the square of the charge). Swords recharge in 0.625 s (speed 1.6), axes in about 1.0-1.25 s, the mace in about 1.67 s, a fist in 0.25 s.

critical_hit.fact: x1.5 damage when attacking while falling (not on the ground), not sprinting, not in water or lava, not on a ladder or vine, not riding, not blind, with the attack at least 90% charged. Jump, then hit on the way down.

sweep.fact: A sword hit on the ground at full charge without sprinting also hits nearby enemies (Sweeping Edge increases that damage).

knockback.fact: A sprinting hit adds extra knockback, then stops your sprint. Re-starting the sprint (releasing and re-pressing forward: w-tap, or s-tap) makes the next hit knock back again. Knockback resistance (netherite armour) reduces it.

invulnerability.fact: After taking damage an entity is immune for 10 ticks (0.5 s); a stronger hit during that time only deals the difference. So at most about 2 full hits land per second, however fast you click.

armor_formula.fact: damage taken = damage x (1 - min(20, max(armor / 5, armor - 4 x damage / (toughness + 8))) / 25). High damage hits get through armour better; toughness counters that.

protection.fact: Enchantment protection factor (EPF): Protection 1 per level on each piece, Fire/Blast/Projectile Protection 2 per level against their type, Feather Falling 3 per level against falls. Total EPF is capped at 20, which reduces damage by 80% (4% per point).

resistance_effect.fact: Resistance reduces damage by 20% per level; Resistance V makes you immune.

strength_weakness.fact: Strength adds 3 melee damage per level; Weakness removes 4.

shield.fact: A raised shield blocks melee and projectiles from the front (within 90 degrees of where you face). Raising it takes 0.25 s before it blocks. An axe hit disables the shield for 5 s (100 ticks). Shields don't block when you're attacked from behind.

axe_vs_shield.fact: Hit a shielding opponent with an axe to disable their shield for 5 s, then switch to your main weapon.

totem.fact: A totem of undying held in either hand prevents a death: you're left at 1 heart with Regeneration II (45 s), Absorption II (5 s) and Fire Resistance (40 s). It doesn't work against the void or /kill. Re-equip another quickly with the swap-hands key.

golden_apple.fact: Golden apple: Regeneration II for 5 s and Absorption I (2 extra hearts) for 2 min. Enchanted golden apple: Regeneration II 20 s, Absorption IV (8 hearts) 2 min, Resistance I and Fire Resistance 5 min.

ender_pearl.fact: Teleports you where it lands; costs 5 damage (2.5 hearts) and has a 1 s cooldown. Used to escape, close distance, or reach high ground.

bow.fact: Full draw takes 1 s and is required for full damage and a critical (sparkling) arrow. Arrows drop over distance; aim higher for far targets. Power adds damage, Punch knockback, Flame fire.

crossbow.fact: Loading takes 1.25 s (Quick Charge removes 0.25 s per level); a loaded crossbow stays loaded and fires instantly. Multishot fires 3 arrows; Piercing goes through targets and shields. Firework rockets can be loaded for explosive damage.

trident.fact: Melee or thrown. Loyalty returns it, Riptide launches you in water or rain, Channeling calls lightning in thunderstorms, Impaling adds damage to things in water (or in rain, since 1.16).

mace.fact: Smash attack: falling before the hit adds damage per block fallen (large for the first few blocks, then less), and resets your fall so you take no fall damage from it. Density adds more per block, Breach reduces armour's effect, Wind Burst launches you back up after a smash. Wind charges and elytra give height for repeated smashes.

fishing_rod.fact: Hooking a player or mob pulls it toward you slightly and resets sprint-like knockback; used to start combos and to pull players off edges.

potions.fact: Splash potions affect everyone nearby, lingering ones leave a cloud. Instant Health heals 4 HP per level step (II = 8), Instant Damage deals 6 (II = 12) and heals undead. Speed +20%/level, Slowness -15%/level, Turtle Master gives Resistance with heavy Slowness.

fire.fact: Fire Aspect and Flame set targets on fire (1 damage per second). Fire Resistance prevents it. Water and rain put fire out.

end_crystal.fact: Placed on obsidian or bedrock and detonated by hitting it: a large explosion (power 6) that deals very high damage nearby. Blast Protection reduces it.

respawn_anchor.fact: Charged with glowstone; using it outside the Nether makes it explode (power 5, bigger than TNT).

fall_damage.fact: Falling deals 1 damage per block beyond 3. Landing in water, powder snow, a cobweb, on slime, in a boat, on scaffolding or climbing a ladder or vine avoids it; hay bales cut it by 80%, beds by 50%. Feather Falling reduces it. A water bucket placed just before landing (clutch) avoids it.
